speaker: Dokurobey
jp: お前たちよくやっただべ
en: You lot did well, y'hear.

speaker: Yanyan
jp: あ!あんたはドクロベエ!
en: Ah! You're Dokurobey!
note: pass 2; pass 1: あんたはドクロべ

speaker: Dokurobey
jp: さあ主役の座を我が輩に渡すだべ
en: Now, hand Top Billing over to me, y'hear.

speaker: Dokurobey
jp: さすればお前たちをメジャーデビューさせてやるだべ
en: Do that, and I'll give you your big-time debut, y'hear.

speaker: Yanyan
jp: どうする、お前たち
en: What do you say, you two?

speaker: Dasainen
jp: メジャーデビューですか
en: A big-time debut?

speaker: Tonmentan
jp: 悪い話ではないまんねん
en: Not a bad deal, I tell ya.

speaker: Yanyan
jp: そうね、私たち主役はおろか、脇役としても出足りないからね。
en: True. We barely make it as supporting players, never mind stars.
note: both passes; pass 1 主役は愚か

speaker: Dasainen
jp: 乗りますか?
en: Shall we take it?

speaker: Tonmentan
jp: 乗るまんねん。
en: Let's take it, I tell ya.

speaker: Yanyan
jp: よし、決めた!
en: All right, it's decided!

speaker: Yanyan
jp: ドクロベエ様、お世話になります!
en: Lord Dokurobey, we're in your hands!
note: pass 2; pass 1: どころでさま

speaker: Itadakiman
jp: いただき!
en: Mine!
note: ? his staff snatches the flower; pass 2: ドロッキー!

speaker: Itadakiman
jp: あ、いただきまーす!
en: Ah, thanks for the meal!

speaker: Itadakiman
jp: いくら日に当たらない生活が長いからって、こんなアイテムに頼ってちゃおしまいだぜ。
en: Sure, you've lived out of the limelight a long time, but leaning on an item like this is pathetic.

speaker: Itadakiman
jp: そんな後ろ向きの了見の奴らには、笑う門に苦よ来い!
en: For a gloomy bunch like you: laugh, and misery comes laughing back!
note: ? twist on 笑う門には福来る, a curse before his attack; was: 猟犬, 笑う角に供養こい, pass 2: わらんかどにくよこい

speaker: Itadakiman
jp: これをプレゼントでい!
en: Here's a present for ya!
note: he blows a swarm of little monkeys at them

speaker: Yanyan
jp: ドクロベエ様、助けてー!
en: Lord Dokurobey, help us!

speaker: Yanyan
jp: 一人で逃げちゃうなんてひどいよ!
en: Running off all by yourself, that's so mean!
note: ? was: 一人で逃げちゃってるなんててるよ; Dokurobey left only a skeleton

speaker: Itadakiman
jp: おー、絶景かな絶景かな
en: Oh, what a splendid view, what a splendid view!

speaker: Itadakiman
jp: ほんじゃ、そういうことで
en: Well then, that's that.
